description: Learn German, English, Spanish, French or Italian – efficiently, easily, and with personalized vocabulary collections! Vocabu lets you create your own vocabulary collections with instant in-app translations, making learning truly personalized and effective. Choose from over 27+ professionally created vocabulary packs covering topics like Leisure & Sports, Travel, Business & Finance, and many more.
